Join Our Telegram Channel For Step by step on how to apply for this scholarship, Subscribe to our YouTube channel Watch our step-by-step guide on YouTube for completing your application Are you an international student seeking financial support to study in the Netherlands? The NL Scholarship 2026 (formerly known as the Holland Scholarship) offers partial funding to non-EEA students pursuing Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees at Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. This €5,000 scholarship is funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture, and Science, along with several partner institutions across the Netherlands. Summary of NL Scholarship 2026 Scholarship Sponsor : Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture, and Science Host Institutions : Participating Dutch universities Scholarship Amount : €5,000 (awarded in the first year of study) Study Level : Bachelor’s and Master’s Eligibility : Open to international students from non-EEA countries Application Deadline : Varies by institution Financial Benefits A one-time grant of €5,000 awarded in the first year Available for students pursuing full-time Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees Not a full-tuition scholarship , but helps cover initial study expenses Eligibility Criteria To qualify for the NL Scholarship 2026 , applicants must meet the following requirements: Must be a non-EEA student Must apply for a full-time Bachelor’s or Master’s program at a participating Dutch university Must not hold a diploma from a Dutch higher education institution Must meet the specific admission criteria of the chosen institution Participating Universities Research Universities Offering the NL Scholarship 2026 Leiden University Utrecht University University of Groningen Erasmus University Rotterdam Maastricht University VU Amsterdam Radboud University Tilburg University Delft University of Technology Eindhoven University of Technology University of Twente Wageningen University Theological University Apeldoorn Theological University Kampen Universities of University of Applied Sciences HZ University of Applied Sciences NHL Stenden University of Applied Sciences Saxion University of Applied Sciences Van Hall Larenstein University of Applied Sciences Zuyd University of Applied Sciences Application Process for the NL Scholarship 2026 Step 1 : Visit the official website of your chosen university. Step 2 : Review the specific eligibility criteria and application requirements . Step 3 : Submit an application for admission to a full-time Bachelor’s or Master’s program . Step 4 : Complete the NL Scholarship application by the university’s deadline (generally March 1, 2026 ). Step 5 : Await confirmation of selection results from the institution. How to Apply? To apply for the NL Scholarship 2026 , visit the official website of your preferred university and follow their specific application guidelines. Official Website : Study in the Netherlands The NL Scholarship 2026 is a great opportunity for international students to study in world-class Dutch institutions with financial support.
